Its two ears rise on either side of your reflection.","You lent him the mirror on Monday, with the usual apology for the damage in one corner. It was taller than any of you. He said the damaged corner would be outside the view. He was building something for the bath’s last open weekend, before the winter drain.","“I wanted you to see it before anyone told you,” he says. “Ada cut the cord.”","Ada March is sitting on an upturned bucket, holding a saucepan by its handle. “Yes.” She looks at him. “Tell the next bit.”","On the spectators’ bench, Miriam Verney has a bag of frozen peas folded around her hand. One sock is wet.","“I asked to come out,” she says. “That is the next bit.”","The viewing cabinet stands beside the pool. It has black cloth walls, a narrow slit facing the high windows, and a rigid door carrying the mirror. The glass is still bolted to that door in pieces. You have been watching your mouth between the rabbit’s ears. You put your own hands in your pockets.
